stem: Jake's seventh paragraph (sentences 27-32) needs a closing sentence. Which of the following should be added after sentence 32 to help close this paragraph?

options.label: F
options.text: This event is held only one month each year.

options.label: G
options.text: They could earn even more money by also selling iced tea and food.

options.label: H
options.text: Everyone who helps run the charity hopes people will continue to support this wonderful event.

options.label: J
